channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: French defense firm Thales to build Japan base, media report says
item.description: Thales Chairman and CEO Patrice Caine told the Nikkei daily that the base "will mark a milestone toward Thales's long-term engagement in Japan."

item.title: Tokyo police to set up section for autonomous driving accidents
item.description: The Tokyo force hopes to accumulate expertise and share it with police departments in other prefectures.

item.title: Japan urges oil stockpiling and development as Mideast risks rise
item.description: The push reflects Japan's efforts to reduce Asia's vulnerability to oil supply disruptions.

item.title: Nishikori appears alongside Federer at retirement event
item.description: At the event held at the Ariake Coliseum indoor stadium in Tokyo, Nishikori held exhibition matches with Swiss tennis legend Roger Federer and others.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
